title: ICE FISH
oneLiner: Two penguins slide, grab fish, and outmaneuver snapping seals before the ice gives way.
hook: Players must choose safe braking lanes or risky long slides through seal patrols: risky routes collect clustered fish faster but make stopping and rescuing a sk
ramp: Each bounded stage opens with a quiet fish line, then adds seal patrols, crossing patrols, and shrinking safe ice gaps one pattern at a time. Pressure peaks during dense schools, followed by a clearow
mechanics: Both players cooperate in one shared scrolling ice arena; each controls a penguin and the team wins by collecting every fish in the stage before the ice route closes.
Left/right steer the penguin while it slides continuously; up gives a short forward shove and down brakes sharply. A and B are unused.
Penguins have momentum: steering is strongest during a slide, braking reduces speed, and touching the water border or a seal causes a brief tumble and loss of one team heart.
Seals patrol marked lanes, pause with mouths closed, then telegraph with a red flash and snap forward; their active bite lasts 0.25 seconds, after which they have 0.45 seconds of harmless recovery.
Fish are collected once by either player for 100 points, with a shared 5-second chain multiplier from x1 to x4 for consecutive pickups; taking damage resets the chain.
A player can bump the other penguin gently, but cannot block fish or seals; players should split routes and can regroup during recovery sections.

Stages contain 12–20 fish and 3–6 seals, with at least one safe lane and a visible warning before every seal crossing. Complete four compact stages; each stage resets positions and hearts while carrying the score.

The first stage teaches steering, braking, and one harmless seal before introducing a crossing patrol. Later stages add moving ice cracks, offset fish routes, and short recovery stretches, capped at four simultaneous seals.

A stage ends when all fish are collected; the team gets a brief clear fanfare. The cabinet ends the run when the shared three-heart supply is exhausted, or after a stage timer expires; the timer is generous enough for deliberate play and pauses during clear fanfare.
artDirection: 256x224 shared overhead arena. Each penguin is 18x20 pixels: black-and-white rounded silhouette, orange beak and feet, colored scarf for P1/P2, with clear idle, sliding, braking, and hurt poses. Fish are bright 6x6 silver-blue sprites with a single sparkle frame. Seals are 20x14 dark gray bodies with pale bellies and oversized snapping mouths; their open-mouth pose is the hazard telegraph. Use a dark navy water border, pale blue ice floes, white cracks, and muted cyan background layers; keep active lanes uncluttered and use warm orange/red only for danger and feedback. HUD space is reserved by runtime; draw directional ice streaks behind sliding players.
lose: Lose one shared heart when either penguin hits a seal, water, or a broken ice edge; the run ends at zero hearts or an expired stage timer.
scoring: 100 points per fish; consecutive fish within 5 seconds build a shared multiplier up to x4, reset by damage or timeout.
